fields.name: visible
fields.meaning: Visible in the course (1) or hidden from learners (0).

fields.name: visibleoncoursepage
fields.meaning: Stealth: at 0 the activity is accessible (when linked or used as a prerequisite ), but is absent from the course page list.

fields.name: groupmode
fields.meaning: Group mode: no groups, separate groups or visible groups.

fields.name: groupingid
fields.meaning: Grouping assigned to the activity (0 = none). IDs only, not names.

fields.name: idnumber
fields.meaning: Freely assigned activity identifier, e.g. for grade calculations.

fields.name: sectionnum
fields.meaning: Section number (0-based) assigned to the activity.

value_range.source: course/modlib.php:799 (Form field "section", relative section number, not the course_sections ID)

fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: The text content of the text card (HTML). Moodle derives the display name from it.

fields.name: introformat
fields.meaning: Text format of the intro (HTML/Moodle auto-format/plain text/Markdown).

pseudo_fields.name: coursepagevisibility
pseudo_fields.meaning: READ ONLY. State derived from visible/visibleoncoursepage and used by read tools. Values: "shown" (normally listed on the course page) or "stealth" (available but not listed). To write, use "visibleoncoursepage" 1 or 0 instead.

value_range.source: Plugin/src/local_coursepilot/classes/catalog/shared_block.php::derive_visibility() (Coursepilot vocabulary, no separate Moodle column; affects visibleoncoursepage)

pseudo_fields.name: availability_status
pseudo_fields.meaning: READ ONLY. State derived from visible/visibleoncoursepage and used by read tools. Includes a third value: "hidden" (visible=0), otherwise "stealth" as in coursepagevisibility or "shown". To write, use "visible" and "visibleoncoursepage" instead.

value_range.source: Plugin/src/local_coursepilot/classes/catalog/shared_block.php::derive_visibility() (Coursepilot vocabulary, no separate Moodle column; combines visible and visibleoncoursepage)

side_effects: Stealth requires allowstealth on the instance; when disabled, the write fails with a clear message instead of silently doing nothing (Spec 0015 §7).
A hidden section hides its activities regardless of their own visible value (Spec 0015 §6).
